new_file_rule.details: eval_tests_aug.patch contains only new file hunks for Lib/test/test_pep695_aug.py and Lib/test/test_pep695_stability_aug.py.

tests.public_surface: ast.parse() and ast.unparse() over public class, function, async function, TypeVarTuple, ParamSpec, and type-alias syntax.
tests.covers_new_lines: measured in coverage_out/coverage_report_union.json after coverage run
tests.rationale: PEP 695 requires type parameter lists to round trip through the public AST for classes, functions, async functions, variadic parameters, ParamSpecs, and type aliases. The test asserts the rendered public source keeps square brackets, stars, double stars, and the type statement.

tests.public_surface: The CPython source distribution shipped in the benchmark image, plus keyword.issoftkeyword("type").
tests.covers_new_lines: measured in coverage_out/coverage_report_union.json after coverage run
tests.rationale: The grammar-change and generic-alias sections require the shipped grammar to define type-parameter productions and the type statement, and require type to be a soft keyword. Source-level checks catch source distribution regressions that generated parser artifacts can mask.

tests.public_surface: typing.TypeVar union expressions with forward-reference strings, TypeVarTuple aliases, and ParamSpec Callable specialization.
tests.covers_new_lines: measured in coverage_out/coverage_report_union.json after coverage run
tests.rationale: The library-change section wires new runtime typing helpers into public typing constructs. The test verifies forward-reference unions work through typing, while invalid multiple-TypeVarTuple and under-supplied ParamSpec substitutions are still rejected.

requirement_sections: Specification > Accessing Type Parameters at Runtime
tests.public_surface: exec() of PEP 695 class, function, and type-alias source plus public __type_params__, __parameters__, __name__, and __infer_variance__ attributes.
tests.covers_new_lines: measured in coverage_out/coverage_report_union.json after coverage run
tests.rationale: PEP 695 says implicit parameters are runtime objects, are exposed in declaration order, infer variance automatically, and drive Generic metadata without explicit Generic bases. The test observes those properties through public class, function, and type-alias metadata.

tests.public_surface: typing.TypeVar, typing.ParamSpec, and typing.TypeAliasType public constructors.
tests.covers_new_lines: measured in coverage_out/coverage_report_union.json after coverage run
tests.rationale: Constructor validation is part of the public runtime representation. The test requires invalid variance combinations, invalid constraints, and non-tuple TypeAliasType type parameters to raise the documented public exceptions.

requirement_sections: Specification > Runtime Representation of Bounds and Constraints
tests.public_surface: exec() of PEP 695 source plus public __bound__, __constraints__, and TypeAliasType.__value__ attributes.
tests.covers_new_lines: measured in coverage_out/coverage_report_union.json after coverage run
tests.rationale: Bounds, constraints, and type-alias values are lazily evaluated public attributes and must cache after successful evaluation. The test uses side effects visible from Python source to prove one evaluation and the correct exposed value.

requirement_sections: Specification > Accessing Type Parameters at Runtime
tests.public_surface: exec() of type-alias statements plus TypeAliasType.__type_params__, __parameters__, __value__, subscription, and union behavior.
tests.covers_new_lines: measured in coverage_out/coverage_report_union.json after coverage run
tests.rationale: Generic aliases must expose declared parameters exactly, expose subscription parameters with the public unpacking semantics, reject subscripting non-generic aliases, and participate in union expressions. The test drives all checks through TypeAliasType objects produced by public syntax.

requirement_sections: Specification > Accessing Type Parameters at Runtime
tests.public_surface: exec() of class declarations plus public __bound__, __constraints__, and __type_params__ on classes and functions.
tests.covers_new_lines: measured in coverage_out/coverage_report_union.json after coverage run
tests.rationale: PEP 695 distinguishes upper bounds from constrained TypeVars and requires __type_params__ to be a tuple, including the empty tuple for non-generic functions/classes. This test checks those public runtime classifications directly.

tests.public_surface: compile() and exec() over PEP 695 source snippets, observing SyntaxError and public __bound__ resolution.
tests.covers_new_lines: measured in coverage_out/coverage_report_union.json after coverage run
tests.rationale: The type-parameter-scope sections require duplicate parameter rejection, prohibit assignment-expression/nonlocal escapes in annotation scopes, and allow nested type-parameter bounds to see the enclosing class namespace. The test checks these outcomes through compile() and executed source.

requirement_sections: Specification > Accessing Type Parameters at Runtime
tests.public_surface: Public ast.TypeVar, ast.ParamSpec, ast.TypeVarTuple, ast.TypeAlias, ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef, ast.ClassDef constructors plus compile() and runtime __type_params__/__value__ metadata.
tests.covers_new_lines: measured in coverage_out/coverage_report_union.json after coverage run
tests.rationale: The AST-change section makes type parameters first-class public AST nodes for functions, async functions, classes, and type aliases. This coverage-focused F2P constructs those public AST nodes manually, compiles them through the normal validator, and observes the resulting runtime metadata.

tests.public_surface: Public typing.TypeVar, ParamSpec, TypeVarTuple, ParamSpecArgs/Kwargs, Callable specialization, tuple Unpack specialization, and class creation error behavior.
tests.covers_new_lines: measured in coverage_out/coverage_report_union.json after coverage run
tests.rationale: PEP 695 moves the type-parameter runtime classes into the C-backed typing runtime while preserving public typing contracts. The test begins with PEP 695 syntax so it is F2P, then covers public dunder, repr, equality, mro-entry rejection, Callable ParamSpec substitution, and TypeVarTuple substitution behavior.

tests.public_surface: compile() over public Python source strings covering PEP 695 class/type syntax plus existing lambda, comprehension, function, async, exception-group, pattern matching, f-string, with-statement, and invalid-syntax grammar paths.
tests.covers_new_lines: measured in coverage_out/coverage_report_union.json after coverage run
tests.rationale: PEP 695 regenerates Parser/parser.c from the public grammar. This coverage-focused F2P first gates on PEP 695 syntax so it fails in the pre-state, then parses a broad suite of public grammar forms to exercise regenerated parser paths and preserve unrelated syntax behavior.

tests.public_surface: Regular Python class/function execution, varargs, loops, and list comprehensions.
tests.covers_new_lines: not applicable; P2P targets non-modified regression surface
tests.rationale: PEP 695 adds generic type-parameter syntax without changing ordinary class/function execution. This P2P pins unrelated interpreter behavior in the same compiler/runtime neighborhood.

tests.covers_new_lines: not applicable; P2P targets non-modified regression surface
tests.rationale: The PR changes parser, compiler, and typing surfaces but should not affect existing string formatting behavior.

tests.public_surface: Public int() parsing and float.hex/fromhex round trip.
tests.covers_new_lines: not applicable; P2P targets non-modified regression surface
tests.rationale: Numeric literal parsing and float round-trip behavior are unrelated public stdlib/interpreter features that should remain stable.

tests.public_surface: sys._getframe() metadata for an ordinary Python function call.
tests.covers_new_lines: not applicable; P2P targets non-modified regression surface
tests.rationale: Regular frame metadata for non-generic functions should remain unchanged while generic functions gain __type_params__.

coverage_validation.measurement_note: Coverage uses the union suite report after excluding generated artifacts Parser/parser.c, Python/Python-ast.c, and Objects/clinic/typevarobject.c.h from the executable denominator; generated behavior is still exercised through public compile()/ast/runtime tests.
coverage_validation.scope: coverage.py for the 5 PEP-695 Python files (Lib/typing.py, Lib/ast.py, Lib/keyword.py, Lib/opcode.py, Lib/importlib/_bootstrap_external.py) + gcov/gcovr for the authored/runtime PEP-695 C source/header files (Parser/action_helpers.c, Python/{compile,symtable,ast,ast_opt,bytecodes,intrinsics,pylifecycle}.c, Objects/{typevarobject,funcobject,typeobject,unionobject,object}.c, Modules/_typingmodule.c, plus all touched pycore_*.h / cpython/funcobject.h / opcode.h headers). Grammar/python.gram and Parser/Python.asdl are grammar / schema sources (non-executable), and Parser/parser.c, Python/Python-ast.c, and Objects/clinic/typevarobject.c.h are generated artifacts, so they are not part of the denominator; generated parser/AST behavior is covered indirectly through public compile()/ast tests.
